recognize_zh: 無淋巴結腫大、以肝腫大與無結石膽囊炎表現的患者，周邊血可見大型不典型淋巴樣細胞（深藍細胞質、可見核仁，見放大插圖），肝臟切片中大型腫瘤細胞塞在肝竇（sinusoid）內，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（intravascular large B-cell lymphoma）的白血病期。
features: PB: scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, open chromatin, and visible nucleoli (inset)
PB: large cells are several times the size of red cells with high N:C ratio
BM biopsy (H&E): hypercellular interstitial infiltrate of large atypical cells between adipocytes
Liver (H&E): large atypical lymphoid cells confined within dilated hepatic sinusoids, without a mass-forming parenchymal infiltrate
Background PB red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, open chromatin, and prominent nucleoli. The bone marrow biopsy shows an interstitial infiltrate of large atypical mononuclear cells. Sections of liver show large neoplastic lymphoid cells filling and distending hepatic sinusoids, with preserved hepatic plate architecture and no discrete tumor mass. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma with a leukemic component; confirmation with CD20/PAX5 immunostaining highlighting intravascular cells is recommended.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS with secondary liver involvement
ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms mass lesions or portal/parenchymal infiltrates rather than being restricted to vessel lumina.
HSTCL is also sinusoidal but consists of medium-sized CD3+ CD4-/CD8- gamma-delta T cells, not large CD20+ B cells.
NK-cell leukemia cells contain azurophilic granules and are CD56+/cytoplasmic CD3+ and EBV-positive, lacking B-cell markers.
HLH shows sinusoidal histiocytes with phagocytosed blood cells rather than large atypical lymphoid cells with nucleoli.
